blocks.content: Approach 1: Solving with O(n2) O(n^2) O(n2) complexity
The problem can be solved simply by using a nested loop.

1def two_sum(num_list, target_value):
2    # iterate over each number in the list
3    for i in range(len(num_list)):
4        # iterate over subsequent numbers in the list
5        for j in range(i + 1, len(num_list)):
6            # check if their sum equals the target value
7            if num_list[i] + num_list[j] == target_value:
8                # return the indices of the two numbers
9                return [i, j]

11num_list = [2, 7, 11, 15]
12target_value = 9
13
14result = two_sum(num_list, target_value)

While the above code gives us the correct output, it is not the most efficient solution for large input sizes. It is possible to solve the same problem with reduced time complexity, which we will attempt next.
